prompts.A: Use case: logo-brand. Create one refined app icon for Markbridge, a local-first Chrome bookmark workspace connecting personal bookmarks to a desktop workspace. A compact solid blue bookmark silhouette with one simple bridge-like negative-space arch connecting the two inner sides, subtly suggesting an M. Bookmark first, bridge second. A single iconic integrated geometric mark, no separate objects. Flat, deliberate, broad readable shapes and generous negative space. At most three flat colors: primary blue #1767D2, deeper blue #114AA3 and white. Square high-resolution canvas, centered mark occupying about 82% of width and height, optically balanced, gently rounded outer corners, truly transparent outside the mark. Simple bold enough to read at 16 pixels. This is a production icon asset, not a mockup. No text, letters, Chrome logo, cloud, arrows, sparkles, gradients, glow, 3D, thin cables, scene, matte background, drop shadow or watermark.
prompts.B: Use case: logo-brand. Create one refined app icon for Markbridge, a local-first Chrome bookmark workspace connecting personal bookmarks to a desktop workspace. selectionBasis: Approved plan recommended A. Root visual review favors bookmark silhouette and broad bridge arch over B folded ribbons; no new user veto. A refined shown inline before integration.
refinementPrompt: Preserve exact bookmark silhouette, placement, rounded corners, bottom notch and white bridge arch. Change only rendering to flat uniform #1767D2 blue and white, remove shading/texture/bevel, retain transparent clean antialiased edges, no new shapes or text.
